package rulefixtures

import (
	"time"
)

// scenario for time_fixedzone_per_call: `time.FixedZone(...)` inside request or loop paths instead of reusing the location.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario680Positive(items []string) []time.Time {
	var results []time.Time
	for _, item := range items {
		loc := time.FixedZone(item, 3600)
		results = append(results, time.Now().In(loc))
	}
	return results
}
